title: PACK-15 voting boundary integrity event payload (v1)
description: Produced by epd2_eligibility_service.voting_trust_events.build_integrity_event. Shared by voting_boundary.cohort_threshold_not_met, voting_boundary.timing_profile_applied, voting_boundary.correlation_risk_detected and voting_boundary.integrity_violation_detected. It deliberately omits identity in every field: a detection names its own id, its context, a risk class, a severity and a reason code, and never the assertion, the credential, the cohort size or the participant that triggered it.
